description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City (Duty Free Operations) Rules No. 1 of 2023 published in the Gazette Extraordinary No. 2333/14 of 22.05.2023 are hereby rescinded
reasoning: The gazette content pertains to the rescission of rules (The Colombo Port City (Duty Free Operations) Rules, No. 1 of 2023) under the authority of the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. This is a regulatory matter involving the modification of subsidiary legislation, which falls squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). The content does not involve government personnel, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories like land or commerce.
